about: A Python library for working out how much power solar panels will make.

prs.title: The library loads on a fresh install again
prs.broken: A recent change made the library need a package that only the test setup installs. On a normal fresh install, loading the library failed straight away.
prs.changed: I switched to the same version check that pandas already ships, so nothing extra is needed.
prs.matters: The next release would have failed to load for many new users. Now it does not.
